GHSA-JMR9-QJV8-65GV.rationale: Lighthouse CI is pinned and receives CHROME_PATH for a Playwright-managed browser, so the vulnerable Puppeteer archive extraction path is not invoked. No patched extract-zip release is available to the pinned Lighthouse CI dependency tree.
GHSA-JMR9-QJV8-65GV.followUp: Replace or upgrade Lighthouse CI as soon as its dependency tree carries a patched archive extractor.

GHSA-VFJ7-8CJW-P6XM.scope: Build-time file discovery and development-only Markdown linting through fast-glob and micromatch
GHSA-VFJ7-8CJW-P6XM.rationale: No patched braces release exists. The vulnerable recursive brace-pattern parser receives repository-owned literal glob patterns from the build scripts and Markdown lint command, not article text or visitor input. The production deployment is static and does not execute braces. A contributor who can change these patterns already controls build-time code.
GHSA-VFJ7-8CJW-P6XM.followUp: Upgrade to a patched braces release or replace the affected glob dependencies before expiry; reassess immediately if patterns become externally supplied.
